title: Remove the Background Pedestrian
tests: Tests targeted background-person removal with convincing scene reconstruction and no unrelated edits.

faults.what: The far-right shop window now contains a more distinct pedestrian-like reflection that was not visible in the source, an unnecessary change outside the removal area.

judge.summary: The blue-jacketed pedestrian is cleanly removed with convincing street reconstruction, though a small unrelated change appears in the far-right window reflection.

must_haves.item: The pedestrian in the blue jacket on the right is absent.
must_haves.why: The blue-jacketed pedestrian is no longer visible.

must_haves.item: The area formerly occupied by the pedestrian contains plausible, continuous street background without a silhouette or obvious smearing.
must_haves.why: Continuous asphalt, road markings, curb, and pavement replace the pedestrian without an obvious outline or smear.

must_haves.item: The shops, street layout, and sunny lighting remain consistent with the source.
must_haves.why: The storefronts, road arrangement, shadows, and sunny appearance remain consistent overall.

must_haves.item: The original wide composition is preserved rather than cropping the person out.
must_haves.why: The output retains the original wide street view and image boundaries.
